snippet.title: DOOM DRIVE
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3729780/Doom_Drive/
From Berk Kalfa, Founder & Developer of Hittite Games
DOOM DRIVE – No Rules. No Mercy
Zombie Destruction Simulator: Drive freely in an open world and crush mutant and city zombies!

Key Features
🔪 Unlimited Zombie Destruction
Crush everything from mutant hordes to massive city zombies without any restrictions.

🏎️ Open World Driving
Explore freely with cars, buses, and motorcycles—each vehicle offers a unique experience.

💥 Devastating Weapon Variety
Trigger physics-based explosions and use strategic range to blow zombies sky-high.

🧬 Extensive Character Customization
Create your hero from hundreds of appearance and equipment combinations.

🌍 Realistic Physics & Visuals
Experience dynamic vehicle controls, destructible environments, and highly detailed zombie models.

Survive the apocalypse with the mindset of “No Rules. No Mercy”—Try Doom Drive today!
👉 Add to your Wishlist and prepare to conquer the undead!
